E019-E020 are distinct OECD claims but same-family evidence. E027 is gateway-only until the primary audit is retrieved.","favorable_and_adverse_search":"Macro conditions and social-policy weaknesses are covered, but competition, property rights, regulation, investment, distribution, and flagship-project delivery remain undersearched.","missing_source_type":"Primary ASF audits, procurement and beneficial-ownership records, sectoral and regional data, and independent project evaluations are missing.","official_claim_independence":"OECD and IMF independently assess macro conditions; CONEVAL independently evaluates social policy.
